commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$(command -v adb || true)"; if [ -z "$ADB" ] && [ -x "$SDK/platform-tools/adb" ]; then ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; fi; test -n "$ADB"; test "$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{n++} END{print n+0}')" -eq 1; $ADB shell monkey -p link.localclimate.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; $ADB shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/lcl-empty-plugs.xml >/dev/null; $ADB pull /sdcard/lcl-empty-plugs.xml /tmp/lcl-empty-plugs.xml >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=ET.parse('/tmp/lcl-empty-plugs.xml').getroot()
texts=[n.attrib.get('text','') for n in root.iter()]
joined='\n'.join(t for t in texts if t)
print('=== PLUGS UI ===')
print(joined)
assert ('No plugs added.' in texts) or ('Brak dodanych gniazdek.' in texts), texts
assert 'No automations' not in texts and 'Brak automatyzacji' not in texts, texts
thermo=None
for n in root.iter():
    if n.attrib.get('text') in {'Thermometers','Termometry'}:
        thermo=n; break
assert thermo is not None, texts
m=re.match(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]', thermo.attrib['bounds'])
assert m
x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups())
print(f'THERMO_TAP={(x1+x2)//2},{(y1+y2)//2}')
open('/tmp/lcl-thermo-tap.txt','w').write(f'{(x1+x2)//2} {(y1+y2)//2}')
PY
read X Y < /tmp/lcl-thermo-tap.txt; $ADB shell input tap "$X" "$Y"; sleep 1; $ADB shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/lcl-empty-thermometers.xml >/dev/null; $ADB pull /sdcard/lcl-empty-thermometers.xml /tmp/lcl-empty-thermometers.xml >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=ET.parse('/tmp/lcl-empty-thermometers.xml').getroot()
texts=[n.attrib.get('text','') for n in root.iter()]
print('=== THERMOMETERS UI ===')
print('\n'.join(t for t in texts if t))
assert ('No thermometers added.' in texts) or ('Brak dodanych termometrów.' in texts), texts
PY
echo '=== FOCUS ==='; $ADB shell dumpsys window | grep -m2 -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' || true; echo '=== ERROR CHECK ==='; if $ADB logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in link.localclimate.app'; then exit 31; else echo NO_FATAL_OR_ANR; fi; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git rev-parse HEAD
